text:
Situation: Metoprolol succinate 25 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 161 tablets at 8.6 per day (18.7 days) and 264 tablets of metoprolol tartrate 25 mg at 13.6 per day (19.4 days). Corvale General holds 393 tablets at 13.8 per day (28.5 days) and 305 tablets of metoprolol tartrate 25 mg at 13.7 per day (22.3 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows metoprolol succinate is not listed as of 2026-10-21. FDA status field reads "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Current inventory provides 18.7 to 28.5 days of supply for the succinate formulation across sites. No active FDA shortage listing exists. Multiple manufacturers not on the shortage list are available for purchase, though their labels do not identify manufacturing plants.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. as the top-ranked option; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Advagen Pharma Limited and Advagen Pharma Ltd. as secondary sources; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. and Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. for additional supply redundancy; requires buyer approval.
4. Pharmacy director to confirm reorder points and safety stock levels for both sites; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Therapeutic interchange to metoprolol tartrate or dose changes at this time; clinical decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
